title: Camera for :name
subtitle: Photos stay on the card in the device. Only an administrator sees copies that arrive here.

forward.title: Forwarding
forward.hint: Off: photos stay on the card only. On: the device may send copies when there is Wi-Fi.

code.title: Pairing
code.hint: The device shows a screen to enter the code. You then confirm here which device it is.

photos.title: Photos
photos.empty: No copies yet. The camera keeps photos on the card and sends them only when forwarding is on and there is Wi-Fi.
photos.older: Copies kept here stay for 30 days. The card in the device is left untouched.

unlink_modal.title: Unlink camera
unlink_modal.body: Forwarding stops and this device can no longer send copies. Photos that already arrived stay until they expire.

flash.forwarding_off: Forwarding is off. New photos stay on the card.

errors.unit_invalid: This room does not belong to this organisation.
errors.code_invalid: This code is invalid or expired.
errors.not_pending: This request is no longer open.
